verdict.rationale: Cognee automatically extracts entities and builds a knowledge graph from raw input in one call, and session memory holds recent interactions. However, consolidation into permanent memory happens through an explicit `improve()` call at the end of a session, not as autonomous background processing. Missing for 10: evidence of salience filtering (the system deciding what is worth remembering vs. storing everything ingested), automatic background consolidation without explicit calls, and independent hands-on corroboration of extraction quality on conversational data.
